tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra ming sring gi drag po'i gtor chen gnam lcags zer phreng bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka karma nā tha ya/ bdud 'dul sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /rab khros bla ma gur mgon la/ /btud de las kyi mgon po yi/ /drag po'i gtor bzlog 'bri bar bya/ /zhes mchod brjod dam bca' nyung ngu sngon du btang nas/ de la 'dir mdo rgyud kun gyi srung ma 'phags bod mkhas grub yongs kyi thugs kyi nying khu rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la sku dang chos kyi bka' babs 'gran bral rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor 'di la rkyang sgrub dang sbags sgrub gnyis/ rkyang sgrub la pho rkyang / mo rkyang / 'khor rkyang gsum la/ phyi ma nyid sbags sgrub kyi tshul du shis par man ngag rnams su gsungs pa bzhin las/ spyir las kyi mgon po pu tra chen po 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum bskang ba bstod bskul dang mdos yig sogs mgon po'i glegs bam rnams su bzhugs pa ltar las/ 'dir drag po'i gtor bzlog bya tshul 'bri ba la/ de yang kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa chen po rgya pad+ma dbang phyug gi gtor ma mgon po'i gtor chen bya tshul dang / mkhas pa yon tan khri'i gtor chen gyi yi ge rnams la gtor chen gyi yi ge rnams la brten zhal gyi gtor chen bya tshul dgos chos rnams sbyor bar mdzad pa bzhin/ 'dir yang zhal gyi gtor ma zhi drag gi yi ge gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung rtsa bar bzung / dgos chos rnams ma 'dres par 'dri ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la bya ba'i sngon 'gro ni/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor byang gzigs dang / sgrub pa po kha lho phyogs su blta ba'i dbang du byas nas sgrub khang gi lho phyogs su/ zhing chen la tshogs bla re bres pa'i 'og tu/ stegs mthon po la zhing lpags sam/

stag lpags la sogs pa bkab pa'i steng du/ mañji'i khar li la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la gri khrag gis dbus su gru gsum che ba rtse lhor bstan/ de'i mdun rgyab dang mtshams bzhir gru gsum chung ba rtse phyir bstan re/ de rnams kyi khar rang nyid bla ma las/ mgon po'i rjes gnang thob skabs kyi nas nag dang sbags pa'i nas nag khrag dang bcas pa'i tshom bu dbus che ba dang / gzhan rnams su chung ba re bkod/ de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin gyis me tog chu gnyis nyer mchod lngas bskor/ tshom bu maṇ+ḍal bcas la dar nag gi gur phub/ de'i mdun gyi sa gzhir/ gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar ba rtse mo lho phyogs bris pa'i mthil du liṅga bris pa'am/ ma bris kyang rung / de'i steng du mañji ches mtho ba'i steng du/ lcags sam 'khar ba la sogs pa drag po'i snod chen por 'bru sna lnga'i phye/ rab bre bco lnga/ 'bring khal phyed/ tha ma bre lnga las byas pa'i gtor ma stod sum gnyis gru gsum dbal can zur rtse rno ba/ pad+ma sum gcig zlum po/ dbus su che ba/ g.yas g.yon gnyis su de'i phyed tsam slebs pa ste gsum bsgrigs kyi mthar mtheb skyu can gyis za 'phro 'dra ba bcad khams phyir bstan drug cu bzhis bskor ba/ khrag dang dur sol la sogs pa'i dmar nag tu bsgyur ba/ 'bru nag gi chan dang / 'khur ba dang / sman dang / 'bru dang / me tog dang / shing thog dang / la du dang / la phug dang / sgog btsong dang / dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum dang / sha chen la sogs pa'i sha sna dang / dri mi zhim pa'i rdzas sna tshogs dang / chang phud la sogs bza' btung sna tshogs pa blugs pa la/ dar nag dang rgyu rlon gyis brgyan pa bsham par bya zhing / de'i nub phyogs su/ bla ma yi dam gur la sogs pa'i rten dang / mchod gtor rgyas pa bsham zhing / khyad par bso phor chang gi gang ba/ rin chen brdar du sogs rin chen phye ma btab pa la/ shing gyi rgya gram la dar sngon sogs kyis bkab pa'i steng gtor ma zur brgyad pa dmar nag rtsi dang /

sha dmar/ rgyan mda' dar sna lnga bcas btsugs pa dang / gtor chen gyi mdun du stegs mdzes pa'i steng du thod pa'i snod rnams su/ dug khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ me tog nag po dri mi zhim pa/ tshil chen gyi bdug pa/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ zhag chen gyi dri chab/ sha chen gyis brgyan pa'i zhal zas/ bshos bu dmar nag rnams shin tu tshang ba sbring tshar du bsham par bya'o/ /de'i byang shar du sgrub pa po'i mdun du 'brub khung brtsigs pa'am/ gru gsum me 'bar ba bris pa'i nang nag por bsgyur zhing / kha la rtsang gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ dgra'i rkang rjes kyi rdul la sogs pa bsregs pa'i bag zan la/ dgra'am bgegs kyi gzugs/ dmigs yul rnams pa 'dra zhing / nyams thag khrag dang khams 'dzag pa/ sgyu lto lug pa/ rma dang shu ba la sogs pas gang ba/ skra g.yeng ba/ yan lag bcings pa bzos te bsgyel la bzhag par bya'o/ /de'i nub g.yas zur du/ bzlas yungs dkar nag ke tshe/ thong phram/ lcags phye/ zangs phye rdo phye rnams bsres pa'i skam thun thod ngan sogs su blugs pa dang / shar zur g.yon du/ glang ru g.yas par khrag sna dang / dug sna bsres pa'i rlon thun blugs pa bzhag gtor chen gyi nub byang du/ gsol kha'i dus su dgos pa'i snod chen po sha dang / 'khur ba la sogs pa'i kha zas sna tshogs pa dum bur byas pas bkang ba dang / gtor chen gyi byang shar du thod pa'am snod gang rung du/ chang dang khrag la sogs pa btung ba sna tshogs kyis bkang ba bsham zhing / gzhan yang bla bre dang / gdugs dang / 'phen dang / mda' dar la sogs pas nam mkha' gang ba dang / go mtshon sna tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang ba dang / gcan zan gyi pags pa la sogs pas bar snang gang ba dang / phyi rten g.yag nag la sogs pas nye 'khor gang ba dang / zhwa nag gos nag la sogs par dgos pa'i rten rnams kyis bar mtshams gang bar bya zhing / tshogs 'khor tshogs dang / sgrub pa po rnams kyi drung rdor dril nang mchod rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar sogs mdor na 'og du gang dgos rnams bsham mo/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la cho ga'i sngon 'gro ni/ sgrub pa po rnams stan la 'khod/ las kyi rdo rjes zlum gtor chus sbyang dpon slob rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥsarba bigh+nān/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣa bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ grih+ṇe daṃ ba l+ya de swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ gang zhig 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sems can la 'tshe bstan la gnod/ /sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /bgegs kyi steng na mthu stobs mchog /gal te bka' las 'das byed na/ /rdo rje 'bar bas 'joms par byed/ /de bas sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /dang ba'i tshul gyis rab khyer la/ /ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs/ /sarba bigh+nan gats+tsha/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa 'di rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rnams drag po mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams la ster ro/ /tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rgyangs ring du dengs shig grogs byed rnams ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las la brtson par mdzod/ ces brjod/ sum bha ni dang / shā sa na drag tu brjod/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang / drag rol rgyun ring du bya zhing / gtor ma phyir dor/ gnas yo byin brlabs nas bzung kyai rdor sogs bla med kyi yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed de'i gtor bsngo/ gur zhal sogs chos skyong rnams la gtor bsngo gang dgos dang / bskang bshags 'phrin bcol bzlog bskul bstod pa sogs rgyas bsdus gang rung / gtor rdzongs lha yi tshogs rnams nas/ kun 'grub shog bar bya/

cho ga'i dngos gzhi la gnas dang mchod gtor byin brlabs/ mgron bskyed cing spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol/ sman raka gtor ma 'bul ba/ bskang ba/ bstod pa/ bskul ba/ liṅga sgral ba/ bzlog bskul rnams las/ dang po ni/ bskang gtor rnams kha gso sbyang bdug bya/ gnas dang mchod gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang chen po yangs shing rgya che bar bskang rdzas rnams dgra bgegs gdug pa can ma lus pa bsad cing bsgral ba'i thod pa stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang du/ dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying khrag dron mo rgya mtshor 'khyil ba/ baṃ chen gsar rnying brag ltar brtsegs ba/ rus rkang thod pa phung por spungs pa/ don snying nang khrol lang ling 'khrigs pa/ zhing chen g.yang gzhi lhab lhub g.yo ba/ ro skra dang rus phreng gi ban bun 'thibs pa/ rkang gling dang thod rnga'i sgra sgrog pa/ steng na bya nag lcags sder mang po lding zhing 'khor ba/ bar nas mi nag gtum po mang po rgod cing rgyug pa/ 'og na rta nag rting dkar mang po rlung ltar 'phyo ba/ g.yag rog zhol chen mang po ri ltar 'gying ba/ lug nag gser mig mang po 'ba' sgra sgrogs pa/ khyi nag dam po mang po khrag rjes gcod pa/ bdud kyi dre'u nag po dang / srin po'i bong bu ga dmar 'dur rgyug byed pa/ dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spung pa/ sman phud bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil ba/ dbang po'i me tog bkrag mdangs gsal ba/ bsur chen gyi dud pa rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ zhun chen gyi sgron mes stong gsum gsal ba/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab gser zhun ltar 'khyil ba/ gzhan yang pho rten rnga yab nag po/ mo rten nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/ gsang rten mda' dar nag po/ srog 'khor bla rdo thod rdzas la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mchod rdzas/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba/ dam can pho mo 'khor bcas mnyes nas dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig la sgrol ba'i nus ldan du gyur/

oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra a warta ya a warta ya hā+oḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi tshom bu/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba las hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag g.yas bskor du 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod na/ ma mo dang / 'dre dang / ro langs la sogs pa mang pos gang ba/ dbus su kaṃ las rkang rus kyi ri rab kyi steng du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa khro las grub pas rtsig pa'i steng du mi mgo'i mda' yab kyi kha nas rgyu ma dang / don snying lnga pa'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ zhing chen gyi rgyal mtshan zur las btsugs pa/ rdo rje'i sdong la mchog gi dral mas phub pa/ maṃ sa'i 'jim pas bsdams pa/ dbus mtho zhing rdo rje dang tsit+ta'i tog byas pa/ bse smug po'i sgo can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum pos bskor ba'i nang du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud thams cad kyi ngo bo mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po che zhing cher 'bar ba/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug dang /

g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa'i gra nas khrag 'dzag pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag 'bum sde gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag 'bum sde 'khong zhing zug pa/ rgyab na ce spyang 'bum sde g.yal zhing rgyug pa/ mdun du mi nag 'bum sde gnam du 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na khyung chen 'bum sde lding zhing 'khor ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du traṃ las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i g.yu'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yog shing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can g.yu yi ral pa len bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba khro mo'i rnam pa can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum gyi mgul na dar nag gi ba dan 'phyar ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/

glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / mi ro rings pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang gser gyi ril bu/ g.yon pa la seṅge dang g.yu'i dril bus brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes par byas pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid cing mi sdug pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wi ye hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang lha mo'i thugs ka'i m+maṃ las tri yig nag po gnyis mched pa ni/ rtsibs gnyis par pad+ma nyi ma ro yi gdan la tri yig dang po yaṃ du gyur pa las/ nag po gnod sbyin mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gser gyi gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon par ba phyir gdengs pa'i lag mthil na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'phyar ba/ dar mon gyi ga sha dang dar gyi ang ga rag byas pa za 'og nag po'i gos dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lding thabs su gyon pa ral pa gyen du brdzes shing gser gyi rna cha 'phyang ba zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs gsum par pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan la tri yig gnyis pa m+maṃ du gyur pa las/ nag mo gnod sbyin mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gser gyi spu gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon par ba phyir gdengs pa'i lag mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'phyar ba dar mon gyi ga sha dang / dar gyi ang ga rag byas pa/ dar nag po gser gyi thig le can gyi gos gyon pa/

ral pa thur du nyil zhing byu ru'i lañcar 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de gnyis la de 'dra ba mang po 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams gang nas las byas pa/ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug+me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ yab kyi thugs ka'i tri las tri yig nag po gnyis dang / yum gyi thugs ka'i m+maṃ las m+maṃ yig nag po gcig mched pa ni/ rtsibs bzhi par dam nyams kyi ro gdan la tri las gshin rje ma rungs pa mon bu pu tra mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas shang lang rab tu 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas dam nyams gyi klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa zhal du gsol ba/ dar nag po'i lhab lhub dang / dar mon gyi ga sha can/ dar dkar po'i ang ga rag gsol ba/ ral pa gyen du gzings shing / rna ba la dung lung 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs lnga par dam nyams kyi ro gdan la tri las bdud ma rungs pa mon bu bha ṭa mdog nag po phyag g.yas dam shing 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas dam nyams kyi snying dmar po khrag 'dzag pa rtsa lag dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ dar nag gi lhab lhub kyi steng du dar mon gyi ga sha can/ stag rlog gyon pa ral pa gzings shing / rna ba la dung lung 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs drug par dam nyams kyi ro gdan la/ m+maṃ las mon mo gser gyi spu gri ma mdog nag mo kha nas me 'bar ba phyag g.yas gser gyi spu gri rnon po 'phyar ba/ g.yon bdug pa can gyi rgyu ma zhal du gsol zhing 'drad pa/ za 'og nag khra'i gos gyon zhing / dar mon gyi ga sha bcings pa/ ral pa thur du 'phyang zhing rna ba la dung lung 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de lnga ka'ang spyan gsum dmar po ldog cing dgra gegs la sdang mig tu lta ba/

zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs nas ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal dang / mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa dang rus pa'i 'phreng bas spras pa/ shin tu 'jigs shing rngams pa dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs skad cig nyid la 'phrog pa'i rnam pa can/ lcam dral gsum gyi thugs kar tri tri m+maṃ gyi sa bon las rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bas 'phrin las thams cad thog med du sgrub pa/ de rnams kyi g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa dpa' bo stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong dgra bcom pa brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba ban+de nag po brgya/ mdun gyi shugs byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ de re re la'ang 'khor 'bum sdes bskor ba/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag mi nag lcags spyang / ce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ gaṇ+ḍi las sprul pa'i dam tshig can rtag tu bsrung ba'i khro bo'i tshogs khro zhing rngams pa/ la la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ la la ba dan g.yab mo g.yob pa/ la la mi rkang gling bu 'bud pa/ la la rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'phen pa/ la la dmar chen rak+ta sbreng ba/ la la tshil chen dud pa gtang ba/ la la g.yang gzhi sa la rdebs pa/ la la hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug sgra sgrogs pa/ la la gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa/ la la spu gri so brdar byed pa/ kha cig dgra bo'i nang khrol dron mo za ba/ la la dgra bo'i don snying spar bas 'debs pa/ thams cad kyang glog gi phung po 'thor ba lta bu'i me lce'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa/ ha ha dang hūm̐ phaṭa kyi nga ro 'brug stong ltar sgrog pa la sogs pa'i mi sdug pa'i cha lugs sna tshogs ston pa/ 'ur 'ur chem chem stong gsum 'gengs pa/ khams gsum thams cad 'dar zhing g.yo bar byed pa/ gzhan yang sgo skyong gi khro mo mgo brnyan can dang /

dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / mkha' 'gro/ sha za/ lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud sprul pa 'bum/ yang sprul bye ba/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ lcam dral de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo dang / khyad par dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad/ lho phyogs bas mtha'i ri sul/ 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi gnas/ bod yul bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang / gung thang na la rtse'i gnas gsar/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang / kha'u'i brag rdzong nag po la sogs pa/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas brten cing bsgrubs pa'i gnas rnams nas/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' bstod pu tra ming sring / las byed ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mchod gtor bzhes shing 'phrin las sgrub pa'i slad du/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la sprin ltar 'thibs shing rlung ltar 'tshubs te byon par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ de nas slob dpon gyi gri lcags kyi dam tshig rdo rjes g.yab/ rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rnga sil rnams bsgrigs te rol mo byin dbab cing / las kyi rdo rje kha cig gis/ dar nag sngags can gyi g.yab mos g.yob cing / khrag chang nam mkhar gtor/ gu gul dang / tshil chen gyi dud pa bya/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ khrag 'thung dpal chen khros pa'i rnam 'phrul mchog ma hā kā la yum chen 'dod khams ma zhes bcug /mgon po'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i ded dpon che/ /stobs chen dam can gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/

/ma g.yel dam tshig dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gnod sbyin yab yum dam dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes tshig bsgyur/ bden tshig grub pa'i bram ze 'khrugs pa las/ /skye 'gro'i srog bdud mon bu pho mor sprul/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mngags gzhug zhing bcu'i gshed/ /bka' bstod lcam dral gnas 'dir myur du byon/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra gnas 'dir byon/ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa gnas 'dir byon/ /sha za srin mo ral cig gnas 'dir byon/ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi gnas 'dir byon/ /mon nag gying chen 'bum sde gnas 'dir༞ /nad bdag ma mo bye ba gnas 'dir༞ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad gnas 'dir༞ /sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa gnas 'dir byon/ /rnal 'byor snying nas gdung ba'i 'bod dbyangs dang / /dar nag g.yab mo g.yob cing khyod 'bod do/ /nam mkha' bar snang char sprin gtibs pa ltar/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs la gnas 'dir byon/ /mi rkang gling bu rnga chen rol mo'i sgra/ /khrag chang btung ba sha rus gtor ma'i tshogs/ /dam can pho mo 'bod phyir bshams lags na/ /sa gzhi rlung dmar ji bzhin 'tshubs la byon/ /khyod ni rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang po ste/ /bdag ni rigs sngags 'chang ba'i sgrub pa po/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas ji ltar bka' bsgos pa/ /dran par gyis la ma thogs da lta byon/ /badz+ra oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ kā la ma hā kā li de wi yak+ṣa e ka dza ṭi/ kā li yak+ṣa si de wi in+d+ri sa'i zhes bcug yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha tra/ ru lu rak+ṣa si sa pā ri wā ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ mngon spyod drag po'i pho brang 'dir/ /gdug can baṃ chen bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /stobs stobs chen mgon po 'khor bcas rnams zhes tshigs bsgyur/ chen mon pa pho mo rnams/ /khro 'khrugs rngam pa'i rol pas bzhugs/ /gang gi sngags kyi rjes su/

sarba bigha nān sha truṃ bai ta a pā na tiṣ+ṭhan tu/ gsum pa ni/ hūm̐ 'bru bcud dpa' bo myos byed chang / /zhing bcu bsgral ba'i snying gi khrag /sman raka rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa 'di/ /las mgon po 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul zhes tshig bsgyur/ mgon pho mo'i zhal du 'bul/ /sngags kyi rjes su ma hā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hī/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba bzhin/ lcam dral las mgon rnams kyi gtor sngags phyag rgya dang bcas kha shas brjod pas so so'i bskang gtor dang / khyad par gtor chen de nyid pu tra 'khor bcas la phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'dod gsol gtor bsngo sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ bzhi pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal ma hā kā la yum chen 'dod khams ma zhes tshig bsgyur/ ldan mgon po'i las mdzad mthu bo che/ /dam can yab yum mon pa lcam sring gsum/ /sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /dam rdzas mchod pa 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes/ /hūm̐ lcang shes rta nag rting dkar rlung ltar 'phyo/ /'brong g.yag rog po zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs/ /bdud lug gser mig lcags ra 'khyil pa can/ /khyi nag dom po 'dur zhing khrag rjes gcod/ /bya nag lcags sder dgra snying 'byin pa'i mchu/ /mi nag gtum po gad mos sa chen g.yo/ /drel nag rting dkar bong bu gwa dmar sogs/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi phyi yi dam rdzas kyis/ /dam gur mgon yum chen dam can thugs dam bskangs zhes bcug can gnod sbyin yab yum thugs dam bskangs/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra'i thugs dam༞ /bdud chen mon bu bha tra'i༞ /kha 'bar srin mo ral gcig༞ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi'i༞ /mon nag dregs pa'i tshogs kyi༞ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hūm̐ḥrnga g.yab nag po nal bu'i rgyal mtshan dang /

/tshad ldan thod pa snying nas gang ba dang / /dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs pa dang / /khrag rgod chang gi btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /bza' bca' ldag pa'i kha zas phyur bur gtams/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i phyag mtshan dar snas brgyan/ /zhwa nag gos nag lhab lhub sprin ltar gtibs/ /stobs chen khyod kyi nang gi dam rdzas kyi/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum༞ gur mgon sogs gong bzhin/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra'i༞ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa'i༞ /kha 'bar sring mo ral gcig༞ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi'i༞ /mon nag dregs pa'i tshogs kyi༞ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hūm̐ smyug rgod tshigs bdun bya rog sgro yis brgyan/ /dar nag 'phyar zhing gnam lcags me 'ur bcas/ /bse dang gri lcags byang bu'i len tshar can/ /dgra bgegs liṅga mi zad khram la btab/ /stag gzig ras mo g.yer kha'i sgra ldan pa/ /dregs pa'i bla rdo rdzas rgod srog snying bcas/ /'khrul med srog gi 'khor lo kha sbyor sogs/ /las mgon dbang po'i gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyis/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum thugs dam bskangs/ gur mgon sogs gong bzhin/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra'i༞ /bdud chen mon bu bha tra'i༞ /kha 'bar srin mo ral gcig༞ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi'i༞ /mon nag dregs pa'i tshogs kyi༞ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hūm̐ dam nyams snying khrag dron mo'i mchod yon dang / /khrag 'dzag dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /gsur chen dud pa'i sprin gyi phyogs kun khyab/ /zhun chen sgron me 'bar bas stong gsum gsal/ /mkhris chen ga pur dri yi ngad ldang ba/ /sha rus bza' ba'i tshogs rnams brag ltar gtsegs/ /dung chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs lhangs se lhang / /dam nyams bsgral ba'i nyer spyod mchod pa 'dis/

/dam can gur mgon sogs gong bzhin/ gnod sbyin yab yum༞ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra'i༞ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa'i༞ /kha 'bar srin mo ral gcig༞ /stobs chen ru 'dren༞ /mon nag dregs pa'i tshogs kyi༞ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /dam nyams dgra gegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hūm̐ dgra bgegs zhing chen g.yang gzhi bla re dang / /rgyu rlon lda ldi don snying tshal par 'phyangs/ /ro skra'i rnga g.yab rus pa'i rgyan drug 'khrol/ /rkang rus dum bus sa gzhi gcal du bkram/ /stag gzig dom dred shun pas phyogs kun khyab/ /go mtshon dpa' bo'i chas rnams rab tu bkra/ /rnal 'byor khros shing drag po'i rgyan gyis bklubs/ /stobs chen gsang sngags nga ro sgrogs pa yis/ /dam can gur mgon sogs gong bzhin/ gnod sbyin yab yum༞ /gsod byed gshin rje pu ṭa'i༞ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa'i༞ /kha 'bar srin mo ral gcig༞ /stobs chen mon nag sde bzhi'i༞ /mon nag dregs pa'i tshogs kyi༞ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /lnga pa ni/ hūm̐ rab 'jigs nag po gnod sbyin ni/ /za 'og gos gyon mi lpags 'phyang / /gri gug 'phyar zhing spar ba gdengs/ /gser gyi rna cha g.yo la bstod/ /bh+yoḥsha za nag hūm̐ rdo rje nag po chen po 'di/ /dur khrod brgyad dang cha lugs mang / /gri gug thod khrag gaṇ+ḍi bsnams/ /gol ba'i stabs kyi bzhugs la bstod/ /bh+yoḥyum chen e ka dza ṭā ni/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs stag baṃ can/ /tshe 'dzin bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i dkyil krung can la bstod/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ni/ /srin mo'i cha lugs 'jigs pa'i sku/ /gri thod rtse gsum mdung 'dzin cing / /bong bu gwa dmar chibs la bstod/ /zhes bcug mo gnod sbyin ni/ /dar nag gos gyon spu gri gdengs/

/bstan dgra'i snying 'byin sbar sha can/ /byi ru'i len tshar 'phyang la bstod/ /hūm̐ pu ṭa mthing nag shang lang 'phyar/ /klad khrag dron mo hub kyis 'debs/ /mon ḍa'i nag po lhab lhub can/ /gsod byed gshin rje khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ gtum chen bha ṭa mun pa'i mdog /dam shing thogs shing dgra snying za/ /stag rlog maṇ+ṭa'i ga sha can/ /bdud pho las byed khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥbadud mo kha nas me 'bar ma/ /gcer mor spu gris dgra snying 'don/ /rgyu rlon 'drad cing ral pa 'phyang / /srin mo nag mo khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ g.yas kyi ru 'dren skyes pa brgya/ /khro zhing rngams pa'i stag chas can/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren dgra bcom brgya/ /gseg shang 'khrol zhing dgra la rngam/ /rgyab kyi ru 'dren sngags nag brgya/ /phur bu sgril zhing ban dmar thogs/ /mdun gyi ru 'dren bud med brgya/ /sbar mo gdengs shing 'o dod 'bod/ /re re'ang grangs med 'khor gyis bskor/ /rgyugs shing 'dral bas stong gsum khengs/ /mi sdug nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /ru 'dren dregs pa'i tshogs la bstod/ /hūm̐ gzhan yang stobs chen khyod kyis bran/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa gsum/ /dgra la thun 'debs mon pa bdun/ /yang sprul mon pa bye ba brgya/ /khrag 'thung dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /lha srin dregs pa'i dmag tshogs la/ /bstod dang gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /drug pa ni/ hoḥdam can gnod sbyin yab yum dgongs su gsol/ /bka' bstod pu tra ming sring da tshul gson/ /ru 'dren dregs pa'i dpung bcas dmag la 'chos/ /mon nag srog bdud gshin rje dgra la bh+yoḥ sngon tshe lho phyogs bas mtha'i ri sul du/ /bden tshig grub pa'i bram zer gyur pa'i tshe/ /skye 'gro srog sdud byed par ma byas sam/ /de tshe bden tshig grub pa da ston cig /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka'/

/sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te/ /srog gi snying po phul nas zhing bcu yi/ /shan pa zhal gyis bzhes pa bsnyel lam ci/ /klu sgrub snying po pad+ma badz+ra dang / /dharmā pa la'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams/ /bsrung zhing skyong bar kha yis ma blangs sam/ /byang phyogs dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag tu/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pas nyin mtshan dus kun du/ /khyod nyid brten cing bsgrubs pa'i dgos pa ci/ /khyad par drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bran du khyod bskos nas/ /dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor ma bzhag gam/ /mi zad rdo rje'i bdud rtsi ma byin nam/ /sngon gyi dam tshig khas blangs ji bzhin du/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel mon bu pho mo'i tshogs/ /sha za khrag 'thung mi zan bla rkun bcas/ /ma thogs rengs pa'i tshul gyis las la 'chos/ /dmar chen gtor ma chen pos khyod bsgrubs na/ /bos pa'i tshe na dam can snying ma ring / /sman raka rgya mtshor bcas nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /bskul ba'i dus su las mgon bang ma bul/ /dka' ba khyad du bsad nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /rbad pa'i dus su stobs chen stsal ma zhan/ /lus srog thad du bor nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /mngag pa'i tshe la srog gshed khams ma chung / /stobs chen khyod la las su gtad pa ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshig bla ma'i sku la bsdo/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde ba 'jam byed cing / /srung ma khyed la do bsdo khyad du bsad/ /rnal 'byor bdag la lha med zer zhing brnyas/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs mi nor 'khor bcas rnams/ /stong gsum 'jig rten gang na gnas kyang rung / /skad cig nyid la mngon sum 'dir khug cig /'jigs pa'i mun chen nag pos mdun nas sus/ /las kyi rlung dmar 'tshubs mas rgyab nas phul/ /gnam gyi 'jug thag dkar po steng nas chod/

/sa ba'i rten phur nag po 'og nas phud/ /dam nyams snying khrag dmar po thang la phos/ /don snying nang khrol dron mo hab kyis thob/ /klad khrag sha rus dmar po chem chen zo/ /mi nor zas gsum thal ba rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag tsam skyong ba'i stsal med na/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji ltar bsrung / /bstan la gnod byed byung tshe mi sgrol na/ /zhing bcu'i gshed mar khas blangs ngo re gnong / /de bas dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las rnams/ /ma g.yel da lta nyid du bsgrub nas kyang / /byang chub bar du srung skyob sdong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod/ bdun pa la skam rlon gyi thun bskyed pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ lha dbye ba/ dpang gzug pa/ bsad las dngos/ ling ro stobs pa las/ dang po ni/ skam rlon gyi thun gnyis a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skam thun hūm̐ las mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi phung po nad dang / dug dang me'i 'od zer 'phro zhing 'bar ba 'ur 'ur sog sog thog thog gi sgra sgrogs pa/ dgra bgegs rnams skad cig la 'joms pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ rlon thun khyu mchog gi rwa'i nang du bh+yoḥ las nad sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin khrag mtsho khol ma dug gi rlangs pa na bun nag po'i khrod nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'khrugs pa/ rba rlabs g.yo shing long long khol bar gyur/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dregs byed thams cad mtshon dang / dug dang / yams nad/ rims nad kyi rnam par bsdus te mdun gyi thun rnams la thim pas skad cig nyid la dgra bgegs thams cad thogs med du 'joms pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇe/ e ka a pañci ma ka lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pā ka ri naṃ/ ya ti pra tī dz+nya sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥtraka rak+ṣa kha muṇ+ṭa/ ru lu ru lu traka rak+ṣa/ snying khrag snying bh+yoḥ spu ta spu ta bh+yoḥ sha sha trag sha sha trag trak+mo tra ya/ snying khrag trak+mo tra pa gnod byed mā ra ya/ oṃ ma hā rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ka ma la rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ gu h+ya rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ hri baṃ rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ma m+ma tsā phur tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ su ru tsa lhuṃ tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smug spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ dh+rig dh+rig ya du pa sha ni sod/ duṃ shig a gad dzaḥ mon bu a gad dzaḥ ya sbri ya sbri mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag la 'jibs dzaḥsnrir na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ tri na rbad/ du na rbad/ mon bu pu tra shaṃ rbad yaṃ rmugs/ lings 'dus/ khaṃ shod pa/ ya mo dzaḥdagra bo'i rus la khrol khrol rbad/ gser gyi spu gri gnod byed kyi snying la yaṃ rbad/ suṃ trig rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ thib thib tsakra bh+yoḥ snying kha rag dun+ti bh+yoḥ rbad rbad tri na shig shig se na gtubs gtubs/ kha rag rbad duṃ bu bh+yoḥ badz+ra tsa tri rak+ṣa tsa trir mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa rnams las/ shā sa na drug cu re bzhi sogs dang / mo'i bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel nas nyer lnga/ pho'i bod rbad bsad gsum bcu gsum/ thun sngags bdun tsam sogs/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la skam thun rlon thun la mchil ma ma 'thor bar phus btab mthar/ thun mchog 'bar ba khyed rnams kyis khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la mnga' mdzod/ dgra bgegs thams cad da lta nyid du tshar chod la brdeg pa'i las mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod/ ho mon bu pu ṭa spun gnyis po/ sring mo nag mo gser gyis spu gri ma ste/

lcam dral rnam pa gsum sku rngams pa'i cha byad dang ldan pa/ gsung 'jigs pa'i nga ro dang ni ldan pa/ thugs gdug pa'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa/ sku la mon tri dar nag gi ga sha gsol ba/ rgyan du mi mgo dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhis brgyan pa/ phyag na dgra satwa dang gsod pa'i gseg shang dang spu gri bsnams pa/ bud med nag mo brgyas gshegs pa'i shul lam 'dren pa/ skyes pa stag chas can brgyas g.yas kyi dmag ru 'dren pa/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa brgyas g.yon gyis dmag ru 'dren pa/ sngags pa nag po brgyas slad kyi rjes nas 'brangs pa la sogs pa/ bdud btsan/ dregs byed dpag tu med pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ bstan pa bsrung ba/ mchod la gdung ba/ dam la gnas pa/ ye shes kyi spyan can/ legs nyes kyi shan 'byed/ bden rdzun gyi shags 'debs/ rnal 'byor pa'i dpung gnyen/ dam can gyi srung ma/ dam nyams kyi snying 'byin/ dgra sdang gi shan pa/ ma rungs pa'i srog gcod/ zas su sha khrag la dga' ba/ las su gnod byed kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams kyi sha la za ba/ khrag la 'thung ba/ rus pa la 'cha' ba/ gzhung pa 'dren pa/ srog rtsa gcod pa/ don snying 'byin pa/ klad pa 'bru ba/ lpags pa mnye ba/ lha ba 'jibs pa/ rgyu ma gzings pa/ mon pa lcam bral khyod bka' la btags pa'i bka' srung / dam la btags pa'i dam can yin pas bka' ma bcag dam ma bral bar bka' ba'i gtor ma rgya chen po bzhes la/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ slob dpon gyi sku dgra/ rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra/ snga dgra thal ba/ phyi dgra shom pa/ da dgra sdang bar byed pa'i sdig can rmad du byung ba rnams tshe'i 'du byed skums/ sgyu ma'i lnga phung shig rgyab brten lha dang phyes/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i brtan phur phud/ lus dang sems su phrog cig sha dang rus su phyes/ mchan gyi bu dang phrol/ sgo ba'i nor dang phrol/ phug gi zog dang phrol/ sdig po che'i sha la zo/

khrag la 'thung / rus la 'chos/ gzhung pa drongs/ srog rtsa chod/ don snying phyung / klad pa brus/ lpags pa mnyes/ lha ba 'jibs/ rgyu ma gzings/ 'khor shig tshang krugs/ yo sgrol/ cho 'phrul thong / smyo ru chug lceb tu chug pho lha dang phyes/ pho sri dang sprod/ dgra lha dang phyes/ dgra sri dang sprod/ mo lha dang phyes/ mo sri dang sprod/ nor lha dang phyes/ god sri dang sprod/ zhing lha dang phyes/ sad ser dang sprod/ gal te de ltar ma byas na dam las 'das pa yin pas khyed gsum brlag par 'gyur ro/ /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mdzod cig ces brjod cing sman raka gi phud gtor bas las la bskul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgug pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas bskul bas/ de rnams las rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med spros/ bsgrub bya'i lha srung thams cad bkug nas/ chos skyong gi bka' 'khor du bcug de nas bsgrub bya dngos bkug nas/ liṅga la bcug par bsam zhing / na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje la sogs pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis༞ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dang / rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog pa'i gzugs can gnyen mgon zhal bzhi pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi༞ khyad par du dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' bstod pu ṭa ming sring / las byed ru 'dren sde bzhi/ gdong brnyan sgo ma rnam bzhi/ 'bar ba gaṇ+ḍi khro tshogs/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthus bla ma'i sku dgra/ bstan pa'i yongs dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa ste/

mdor na rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud sde rnams su mngon spyod kyi las bya bar gsung ba'i yul du gyur cig gang la mngon spyod ma byas na rdo rje 'dzin pa la rtsa ltung bcu pa 'byung ba'i rkyen du gyur pa'i gdugs pa can bsgral bar 'os pa de dag thams cad mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dma' ba dmyal khams yan chad gang na 'dug kyang / rang dbang med par khug la liṅga 'di la chug cig snri yaṃ dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ oṃ ro ru sogs mo'i bod pa dang / a li sogs pho'i bod pa'i mthar/ sarba sha truṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rol mo'i sgra drag po dang / bshugs pa'i sgra tshogs bya/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ seng ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod pas pho nya rnams kyi nang nas seng ge'i gdong can lcags kyu thogs pa zhig gis dgra bgegs de liṅga'i spyi bor khrid de/ chu'i khams kyi nus pa thams cad nyams par byas/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ a d+ye mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ gzig gi gdong can ser mo zhags pa thogs pa zhig gis/ dgra bgegs de liṅga'i spyi bo nas thogs med du bstims nas/ sa'i khams nyams par byas/ oṃ ri kha si mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ dom gyi gdong can dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pas bkug pa dang bskyed pa'i liṅga chu la chu bsres pa ltar dbyer med du byas shing / me'i khams nyams par byas/ dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ rak+ṣa mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra a we sha hoḥ dred kyi gdong can ljang khu tho ba thogs pa/ dgra bgegs brdungs pas myos nas dran med du song bas/ rlung gi khams nyams par byas par bsam/ de ni sgo ma bzhi'i gnad kyis dgug pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de 'dra tshar gsum/ gsum pa ni/ dzaḥ rje btsun nas/ bsgral bar 'os pa de dag thams cad bar gong bzhin gyi rjes su bsrung skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phyes cig bsrung zhing sdong grogs mgon skyob byed pa'i lha dang phyes cig

pho lha/ dgra lha/ zhang lha/ srog lha/ yul lha la sogs pa'i lha dang phyes shig bsrung 'khor dang yi dam dang chos skyong la sogs pa'i nus mthu dang phyes shig rol mo sogs gong bzhin dang / traka rak+sha nas snying khrag trak+mo tra sa'i bar mo'i rbad pa dang dh+rika dh+rika nas mon bu khrag la 'jibs dzaḥ bar pho'i rbad pa gnyis kyi mthar sarba de wa bi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ dgra bgegs kyi rgyud la yod pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi nus mthu/ gnas skabs su bla mas dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i dus su gsal btab cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nus mthu thams cad oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par bsdus te/ bya tshang nas 'phur ba bzhin thogs med du byung nas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin sngar las kyang gzi brjid nus pa che cher gyur par bsam/ kho'i lus de bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang bral bas sdong po rnying pa nyi lhag gis khyer ba ltar nag hrul gyis song bar bsam/ bdag gis sngags bzlas pas gnas gsum nas me dang mtshon cha'i tshogs spros pas/ byad ma bsrung skyobs byed pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad dpag tshad rgya'i bar du bskrad pas mgon skyabs dang bral ba mig rig rig 'dar yed yed 'dug par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ rnga brdung zhing / dkon mchog gsum la smod pa dang / /slob dpon la ni sdang ba dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi/ /byad dang rbod gtong byed pa dang / /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa yi/ /mi dang mi min gang ci'ang rung / /nag po khyod kyis 'dir khug la/ /liṅga 'di la myur du chug /bsrung ba'i lha rnams kun dang khrol/

/mthu dang nus pa nyams par gyis/ /hūm̐ 'di yi spyi bor khyod 'dug la/ /til tsam ma lus gsol bar gyis/ /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung / /klad pa rus pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs brgyud rtsa nas chod la shog /'dza' bo kun dang phrol la thong / /tshe srog chod la med par mdzod/ /bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /lnga pa ni/ ral gri thogs la/ stangs stabs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gcig gyur nas/ /shin tu drag po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bgegs 'joms pu tra ming sring khyod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i las bya bar/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang nas bzung ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' yis bsgos/ /ming sring rnams kyis zhal yang bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bsgrub kyang bsgrubs/ /de bas dam bca' ma g.yel bar/ /drag po'i 'phrin las da mdzod cig /gsod byed pu tra'i dus la babs/ /bdud chen bha ṭa'i༞ kha 'bar sring mo'i dus༞ /ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dus༞ /gdong brnyan rnam bzhi'i dus༞ /dregs pa pho mo'i༞ /lha srin sde brgyad༞ /dam nyams gdug can dgra bgegs 'di/ /bsgral ba'i 'os dang dus yin gyi/ /khyod kyi phrin las drag po yis/ /da lta nyid du thal bar rlog /ces brjod la rol mo drag po sogs gong bzhin bya zhing / oṃ ma hā rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ nas/ tsa lhuṃ tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ bar mo'i bsad pa dang / snri na rbad nas snying la yaṃ rbad bar pho'i bsad pa gnyis brjod la/ skam thun rlon thun grab ral gris dum bur gtubs la/ de'i sems hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa/ bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi shangs bug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ dhū ti'i lam dag pa nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pas/

skad cig la he ru ka ye shes kyi sku can du gyur pa la/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'ja' gur dang spos kyis gtibs shing rol mo dang me tog gi char dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ skad cig de nyid la 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ phaṭa drag po brjod cing / mig gyen du yun ring du blta/ rang gi sems dang bsgral bya'i sems sgrol byed kyi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa rnams ro gcig tu bsres nas/ 'dzin med blo 'das kyi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par 'jog go /drug pa ni/ ling ro gtor bsngo'i gtor ma bskang gtor gtor chen bcas la phul la/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'dzin dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka'/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can nus pa'i stsal/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung chos dbyings bden pa'i stobs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /khro bo pho nya 'bar ba'i tshogs spros te/ /shugs drag rdo rje'i mtshon chas rab bsnun nas/ /sha khrag rus pa'i phung por bcas pa 'di/ /ye shes bdud rtsi chen por byin rlabs nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhal du bstabs/ /gur mgon ral gcig 'dod khams zhal du bstabs/ /gnod sbyin yab yum rnam gnyis zhal du bstabs/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra'i zhal du bstabs/ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa'i zhal du bstabs/ /kha 'bar sring mo ral gcig zhal du bstabs/ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi'i zhal du bstabs/ /gdong brnyan sgo ma rnam bzhi'i zhal du bstabs/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud zhal du bstabs/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad zhal du bstabs/ /sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul zhal du bstabs/ /mdor na gtso 'khor yongs kyi zhal du bstabs/ /zhes dang / las mkhan pho mo'i bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel nas nyer gcig sogs bzlas pas/

de'i sha khrag bla ma yi dam chos srung spyi dang / khyad par pu tra 'khor bcas kyi/ zhal du sib sib song bas til tsam yang ma lus par gsol bar bsam/ bdun pa ni/ stan las langs te byang nas lhor phyogs pas/ hūm̐ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag rngams pa'i sku/ /shang lang dam shing spu gri 'bar ba g.yas/ /klad khrag snying dmar rgyu rlon g.yon na thogs/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam dbu la bcings/ /mi mgo'i do shal sbrul dang rus pas brgyan/ /dkar nag dar gyi ang rag lhab lhub dang / /stag slog za 'og nag khra'i gos gyon zhing / /dam nyams ro steng brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bstod pu tra ming sring bstod/ /snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon dpa' bo che/ /gsang ba'i las mgon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can/ /phrin las mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje bdud dang gnod sbyin dbang phyug che/ /dregs pa'i ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu bo che/ /srid gsum za byed khyod la bdag bstod do/ /de nas sngar bshams pa'i kha zas dum bu rnams gtor ma la nar mar sbron zhing / hūm̐ mgon po'i mtshan gsol gsang ba'i las mkhan lnga/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo las mgon 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i las mgon 'khor bcas la/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dges pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/

/mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams 'grub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / hūm̐ dpal ldan las mkhan nag po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ /lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ /dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ /dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ /bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra/ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa/ /sha za sring mo ral gcig /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi/ /gdong brnyan sgo ma rnam bzhi/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ /bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi bdud pho/ dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mgron no/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gnod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams spel du gsol/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba dbang du bsdus/ bar chad dgra gegs rdul du rlog rgyags chad kyi ma mdzod/ blo lhag gi pha mdzod/ rgyab kyi slog pa mdzod/ mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud/ brjed na skul/ mgo gang gi yar la stod/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings/ legs pa brgyad dang sprod/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol/ bsam pa rgya mtsho sgrubs/ re ba rgya mtsho skongs/ mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams zlog dgra dpung thams cad choms/ bgegs dpung thams cad shig

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod/ spo la dar 'phyor/ khrom du dung bus/ grags pa 'jig rten kun tu sgrogs/ dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor shig ces pa'i gsol kha dang / bcol bskul bya'o/ /de bzhin du shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / slar yang byang nas te/ de lta bu lan lngar bya zhing / gzhan yang gang 'dod kyi smod bskul bya'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ hūm̐ gnod sbyin yab yum mthu ma chung / /pu tra ming sring thugs ma g.yel/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi bang ma bul/ /pho nya las mkhan stsal ma zhan/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las mgon po ni/ /khram kha sgyur ba'i mthu bo che/ /bdud kha sgyur ba'i nga ro can/ /do nub bzlog bsgyur dus la babs/ /srid pa'i khram kha da gyur cig /lha 'dre'i dmag sna dgra la drongs/ /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa yi/ /phur pa'i dpal kha 'phen pa bzlog /'tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa bzlog /'byung po'i thod zor 'phen pa bzlog /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog /bdud kyi khram kha ston pa bzlog /ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa bzlog /klu yi byad du bcug pa bzlog /the rang srid la brku ba bzlog /mu stegs bar chad byed pa bzlog /rgyal po'i smyo 'bog btang ba zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu bzlog /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ltas sdig /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog /lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg bzlog /drang srong gza' yi king kang bzlog /zhang zhung gtso dmar 'phen pa bzlog /sum pas glang zor 'phen pa bzlog /ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa bzlog /bon pos dbal zor 'phen pa bzlog /skyes pas mda' zor 'phen pa bzlog /bud med dmod zor 'phen pa bzlog /rlung gi bshed bzhi mchis pa dang / /mo rtsis ngan pa thams cad bzlog /mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang / /rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa bzlog /de la sogs te gdug sems rnams/

/thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ thams cad rbod gtong steng du bh+yoḥ las kyi mgon po mthu rtsal can/ /'phrin las drag po mi bzad pas/ /sod cig thul cig dgra gegs rnams/ /gtad do gnyer ro thugs dam can/ /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du phyung / /le lo g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag gi dpal dang grogs mdzod cig /bdag gi 'khor dang longs spyod kun/ /rtag tu bsrung skyob gnyer mdzod cig /ces bzlog pa tshar gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa dang / dgu pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal ldan mgon po'i bka' 'khor nas/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum bskyod/ /me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /mi zan pu tra ming sring bskyod/ /phyogs bzhi'i dmag gi rna 'dren pa/ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi bskyod/ /snang srid yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dregs byed lha srin sde brgyad bskyod/ /khrag zhag khol ma'i rba klong nas/ /srog bdud mon nag gshin rje bskyod/ /bstan dgra 'joms byed grong khyer nas/ /sprul pa ltas ngan cho 'phrul bskyod/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs lhangs se lhang / /bh+yoḥyi 'bod sgra di ri ri/ /bshugs pa'i glu len kyu ru ru/ /rgyob gsod nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /phyogs kun mun nag thibs se thib/ /mtshon cha'i me stag skar ltar 'khrugs/ /khrag nad bu yug char ltar 'bab/ /'jigs rung rlung nag tshubs se tshubs/ /shan pa'i gri bskor ling se ling / /ma mo'i khrag zor mda' ltar 'phen/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul zing se zing / /dgra ming bla 'bod lhang se lhang / /kun kyang khro gtum ri rab tsam/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dgra snying 'byin/ /las mdzad mon pa pho mo'i tshogs/ /khyed la mthu dang rtsal yod na/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i yul khams su/ /khrag nad dal yams gzer chen phob/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul pho nya khyes/ /glo bur ye 'drog sna tshogs thong / /dgra snying dmar po spar gyis thob/ /dgra khrag dron mo hub kyis drongs/

/zhing chen g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /thod rus rgyu rlon rgyan du gyis/ /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /zhag dang za ma'i dus nyid la/ /dgra bgegs dpung dang bcas pa rnams/ /til 'bru tsam yang med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag cag gi /'khor du gtogs pa'i skye dgu rnams/ /khyod kyis bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /las bzhi lhun gyi grub par mdzod/ /ces bya'o/ /de nas tshogs yod na lhag gtor bar rdo rje'i glu/ shis brjod smon lam spyi btabs rjes chog rnams rgyun bzhin bya zhing / tshom bu'i lha la brtan bzhugs rnams so/ /tshul de lta bu'i zhag sgrub dang / gal te zhag sgrub mi byed na gsol ka'i rjes su tshogs byin rlabs nas/ phud 'bul ba'i bar byas la/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bskul ba/ gser skyems dpang gzug zor lam dbye ba/ 'phang ba/ rjes chog rnams las/ dang po ni/ gtor chen las kyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyis gsol ba'i lhag ma de nyid dug mtshon nad yams khrag mtsho sogs/ dgra bgegs 'joms shing rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i nus ldan du bsams la thog mar sngar gyi rlon thun snod bcas dang / skam thun lhag rnams gyo mo gru gsum gsum la tshogs par sogs nas blugs kha bcad pa rnams snod du bcug pa dang / de'i rjes su gtor chen sgo la phyogs par bzhag dkar lam 'then/ bzlog dkyil gru gsum pa bsubs/ chas pa'i sngon du dar nag sogs 'phyar/ gu gul tshil chen gyi dud pa gser skyems kyis sna drangs/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rnga rol sogs 'khyer/ slob dpon drag po'i chas su zhugs/ ban phur thogs shing / dpon slob rnams kyi rgyab nas dmag dpung dang / dge 'dun mdo sgrub pa sogs gang 'grig dang bcas bsgrigs la/ hūm̐ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gi /srog gi snying po phul nas dam bcas pa/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gtso bo dpal ldan nag po che/

/lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas/ /rnam 'phrul du mas hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrogs shing / /ha ha'i gad rgyangs srid gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ /ru ru ro zhes gdug pa'i khrag rgyun gsol/ /ma ra'i sgra 'byin gsod la brtson rnams kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /bstan la gnod byed gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dam bca' ji bzhin myur du mngon par khug /gṛh+na ban+dhas bzung zhing bcings nas ni/ /ha na da has bsdus cing brdeg par mdzod/ /pa tsa pa tsas bsregs bcad gtubs nas ni/ /ma rā mā ras myur du bsgral ba yi/ /sha khrag las grub mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/ /kha kha khā his legs pa ston pa yis/ /rang gi sha gcod brtul shugs bzlog nas ni/ /dam nyams snying khrag dbugs la myur du rol/ /gzhan la 'khu byed gtor ma'i las brtsams kyis/ /kha 'jam sems gdug rang gi phyogs 'dzin cing / /bu ltar gces pa'i gsang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ /myur du tshar gcod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /hūm̐ bh+yoḥmagon po ma hā kā la dang / /lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral gyi/ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin pho mo'i gzugs/ /drag la rngam pa'i cha byad can/ /glog 'khyug ma ra'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /dgra bgegs baṃ ril khrag la gzer/ /snying khrag 'thung zhing mchongs shing rgyug /kha rlangs 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i sbar shad kyis/ /don snying drangs nas zhal du gsol/ /thog gi gzer 'debs khyod la bstod/ /lcam dral bka' bstod mon pa'i gzugs/ /las kyi mgon po ming sring las/ /mon bu pu tra nag po khyod/ /mon gyi ga sha sku la gsol/ /shang lang 'bar ba phyag na bsnams/ /mon bu pu tra khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha ṭa stag slog bkra/ /dar gyi ga sha sku la gsol/ /sher shing gsal shing phyag na bsnams/ /bha ṭa nag po khyod la bstod/ /sring mo gser gyi spu gri ma/

/nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /bdud mo nag mo khyod la bstod/ /bka' yi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor can gyis bcol pa'i las/ /ma g.yel brtson pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /da lta sgrubs shig sa ma ya/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya yis/ /legs sgrubs bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i zas/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma bzhes/ /dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas bzhes/ /sman raka phud kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /mnyes pa'i gtang rag chen por 'bul/ /dam tshig bcol pa'i las la dgongs/ /'khor bcas srung zhing skyong ba dang / /dgra bgegs log 'dren gzhom pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /ces brjod la zor rnams btegs/ rnga rol sogs gang du chas pa rnams/ phyir thun te 'phen par slebs pa dang / gnyis pa gser skyems dang / gsum pa dpang gzug bzhi pa zor lam dbye ba rnams mgon po'i man ngag spyi 'gre byas la/ lnga pa ni/ gong bzhin bzlog bskul/ de nas rwa zor thogs la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las kyi mgon po pho nya ni/ /mdun nas gshegs pa'i shugs 'dren pa/ /bu med gri thod thogs pa brgya/ /bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo/ /chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /'phang / yang skam zor thogs la/ g.yas nas ru 'dren dpa' rtsal can/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /g.yon nas ru 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /dge slong 'khar sil thogs pa brgya/ /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /rgyab kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba/ /ban+de nag po phur thogs brgya/ /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /ces bskul re re la re re 'phen/ de nas gtor chen 'phen pa'i phyir/ gtso bo bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ mon bu pu tra gnas nas bskyod/ /mon gyi ga sha sku la gsol/

/sher shing gseg shang phyag na bsnams/ /pu tra nag po khyod la bstod/ /bskyod cig pu tra nag po bskyod/ /rtags kyi mon nag mched gnyis bskyod/ /mgon po'i bka' 'khor nag po bskyod/ /lcam sring 'khor bcas ma lus bskyod/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du bskyod/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la zhugs/ /srog rtsa chod la snying khrag rngub/ /ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la thong / /phyag cha sher shing gseg shang gis/ /bstan pa'i dgra gyur bdud kyi klad/ /'gems byed sher shing gseg shang rnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i klad la rgyob/ /zhags pa skra thag nag po yis/ /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /dkon mchog gsum la smod byed pa/ /de yi mgul chings khrid la shog /pu tra nag po'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di sgrub/ /hūm̐ mon bu bha ṭa stan las bskyod/ /dar gyi ga sha sku la gsol/ /phyag na spu gri rnon po bsnams/ /bha ṭa khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bskyod cig bha ṭa nag po bskyod/ /nag po las mkhan dgra la bskyod/ /phyag cha gser gyi spu gri yis/ /dgra bo'i don snying lnga po yi/ /srog rtsa chod la snying khrag rngubs/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /shan pa nag po'i dus la babs/ /bstan bsrung las kyi bya ra mdzod/ /bh+yo bh+yo/ sring mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /phyag na gser gyi spru gri bsnam/ /nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bskyod cig nag mo spu gri bskyod/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin nag mo bskyod/ /dam tshig rjes gcod nag mo bskyod/ /nag mo 'khor bcas thams cad bskyod/ /phyag mtshan spu gri 'bar ba yis/ /bstan la gnod byed dgra bo yi/ /srog gcod snying khrag dron mo 'thung / /nag mo 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /rims dgu nad zer dgra la thong / /bstan srung las kyi bya ra mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ de nas gtor chen phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar te/

dgra gegs dmigs kyis gsal ba'i snying ga na/ rnam shes kyi ngo bo a thung til mar gyi mar me lta bu de la brgyab pas/ chus me bsad pa'am/ mar me la g.yab tho brdabs pa ltar nag thum gyis song / kho'i rgyud kyi gnod sems sbyor rtsub thams cad bde chen gyi ngang du thim par bsams la/ rang gi sems dang bsres la lta ba 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci gnas 'jog cing / gtor ma kha sbubs su brdab/ zhing lpags sam/ chos gos kyi g.yab mo lan gsum brdab/ chos skyong rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa longs spyod thams cad gsol nas rjes med du btang bar bsam/ de nas bsrung 'khor gsal btab/ thams cad phyi mig mi lta bar sgrub khang du log go /drug pa ni/ de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol ba/ rgyun gtor 'bul ba/ mjug chog rnams rgyun bzhin la tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang la thim pa'am/ yang na gong dkar rdo rje gdan lta bu'i gdan sa khyad par can nas phyir 'khyar mi dgos pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku yod na/ de nyid la thim pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa sogs ni bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bzhed pas gur zhal rnams kyi man ngag las mi bya bar gsungs/ go bsgo ba bsngo smon shis brjod sogs so so'i gzhung dang / phyag len bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog cing / gdug pa can tshar gcod pa dang / mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /zhes dpal phrin las kyi mgon po dam can pu tra ming sring gi drag po'i gtor chen bya tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ gang rdo rje gdan gyi zur 'chad pa kun dga' chos 'phel nas 'di bzhin dgos lugs lan cig min par yang yang byung ba'i zhal ngo ma cog par/ rtsa ba'i yi ge kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa chen pos mdzad pa'i zhal gyi gtor ma zhi drag gi cho ga gnam lcags 'bar ba la 'di'i khyad chos gong ma'i yig rnying bskul tshigs bcad lhug dang /

tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gur lha brgyad gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kyi stobs 'phrog rol pa gtor bsngo 'phrin las myur 'gyogs/ bskang ba las bzhi lhun grub/ de'i bskang rdzas byin rlabs rnams dang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i gur lha brgyad kyi maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod/ nged rang nas bsgrigs pa'i mgon mdos rgyas pa/ las mgon lnga'i thug chog rnams nas skabs su gang babs bsgrigs te/ don la rang bzo'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang med khul 'di la nyes tshogs mchis na dpal sa skya'i man ngag 'dzin pa rnams kyis dag ther mdzad grogs dang / chos srung rnams nas nyes pa bzod par bzhes te 'di'i dge bas rgyal bstan spyi bye brag la gnod byed log smon can rnams lo zla ma 'gyangs par bsgral nas/ bstan 'gro'i dge legs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig yi ge pa'ang rang nyid kyis bgyis so// ༈ /nged rang gis bsgrigs pa'i pu tra'i gtor bzlog gnam lcags zer phreng la/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi 'don khrigs dbyangs rol rnams sbyor tshul ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma bsngo ba rgyun bzhin rnga brdung la/ hūm̐ gang zhig sogs 'das dang ma'i gdangs rol mo/ rgyun bzhin chems brdung sbugs la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma sogs dang sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ 'jog lugs rgyun bzhin/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas gtor rdzong gi kun 'grub shog bar rgyun par mdzad pa'i zhal gyi gtor bzlog bzhin la zhal gyi dmigs bsal rnams dang gtor bsngo'i bzlas grangs bskang ba sogs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs las 'char can mi dgos/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs nas s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ bar/ mdun bskyed sgrub skabs a mṛ tas bsangs ba nas bzhugs pa'o/ /bar/ oṃ shrī sogs tshar gcig mgon po'i nas las byed pa bar/ a li sogs tshar gcig oṃ ro ru sogs tshar gcig

yab kyi nas sa mā dzaḥbar/ de nas langs la slob dpon gyis rdor dril g.yab dar gzhan rnams kyis bcom dung rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar sogs dang bcas thog mar rol mo rgyun bzhin bcom la/ chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar 'phar chen sngon 'gro'i 'phar chung gsum 'phar chen gcig byas gcig gnyis byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi byas/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga byas/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug byas/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun byas/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun brgyad byas/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun brgyad dgu byas bar 'phar blangs/ sum brdung nas sde tshan re tshugs pa dang rkang gling g.yab dar/ de nas 'phar med gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun brgyad dgu byas/ de bzhin rigs 'gre sbyar ba'i brgyad rdung / bdun rdung / drug rdung / lnga rdung / bzhi rdung / gsum rdung / gnyis rdung / chig brdung bar byas pa'i lnga rdung skabs rkang gling g.yab dar/ yang chig brdung byas nas dgu brdung bar yar rim bzhin spar ba'i lnga rdung skabs rkang gling g.yab dar/ dgu rdung gi dgu byas kyi rjes su 'theng rkang gnyis chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar/ chems brdung rdzogs nas sum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas dung chen yod na 'dol byas la bzhag de nas spyan 'dren khrag 'thung sogs ni tshar chen rin po che'i gsung ma bsgyur par bzhag pa yin/ de nas/ mahā kā la yum chen 'dod khams ma/ mgon po'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i ded dpon che/ gnod sbyin yab yum dam dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs la hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin ma'i dbyangs rol dzar ring dang sum brdeg len can rkang gling g.yab dar/ bden tshig sogs la'ang dbyangs rol rkang gling g.yab dar gong bzhin/ gsod byed sogs la'ang de bzhin 'dur shur gang rung / sa gzhi rlung dmar la tshig rol dgu brdung rkang gling g.yab dar/

khyod ni rgyal ba'i nas 'dur shur gang rung / dran par gyis la tshig rol dgu rdung / chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar rdzogs nas sum brdeg len can/ de nas slob dpon gyis g.yab dar bzhag rdor dril dang / hūm̐ mngon spyod sogs 'dur shur gang rung / khro 'khrugs la tshig rol sum brdeg chems brdung rdzogs nas bsum brdeg len can rdo dril bzhag hūm̐ 'bru bcud sogs 'dur shur gang rung / mgon po 'khor bcas la tshig rol sum brdeg chems rdung / slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis sman raka 'thor ba'i stangs ka rdzogs nas sum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la gral la 'dug dung chen la 'dol/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya sogs nas ba liṃ di swāhā'i bar gsum/ shā sa na gsum/ lha mo'i sngags lan gsum/ a li dang / oṃ ro ru sogs kyi mthar gtor sngags btags pa gsum rnams rdor thal se gol bcas gtor ma bsngos la ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhuṣ+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ so so'i phyag rgya bcas phyi mchod/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'thor la oṃ ā hūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring / 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du sogs gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis 'phrin bcol byas la/ bcom dung rol mo rgyun bzhin bcom/ chems brdung rkang gling 'phar chung gsum/ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum byas gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig zhes bzhag hūm̐ bh+yoḥm hā kā la yum chen sogs sh+lau ka gcig la hūm̐ 'dren yod pa'i mgon po 'khor dang ma bcug la/ tshig bdun ma dang dgu ma'i khyad bsgyur rol mo sum brdeg len can rkang gling med/ hūm̐ cang shes nas 'dur shur gang rung / dam nyams sogs la tshig rol sum brdeg hūm̐ rnga yab sogs sh+lau ka gcig la gang thugs ma'i dbyangs rol rkang gling med/

bza' bca' nas 'dur shur gang rung / dam nyams sogs la rol mo gong bzhin/ hūm̐ snyug sogs sh+lau ka gcig la khril mchod ma'i dbyangs tshig rkang bdun dgu'i khyad bsgyur sum brdeg len can/ stag gzig nas 'dur shur gang rung / dam nyams sogs la rol mo gong bzhin/ hūm̐ dam nyams sogs sh+lau ka gcig la nag po gnod sbyin ma'i dbyangs rol tshig rkang bdun dgu'i khyad bsgyur rol mo'i skabs rkang gling mgon po 'khor dang ma'i dbyangs la byed pa bzhin/ mkhris chen nas 'dur shur gang rung / dung chen gling bu'i la rkang gling gdangs gcig dam nyams sogs kyi rol mo gong bzhi la rkang gling mgon po 'khor dang ma'i dbyangs lugs/ hūm̐ dgra bgegs sogs sh+lau ka gcig la yang dag don du'i dbyangs rol rkang gling med tshig bdun dgu'i khyad bsgyur/ stag nas 'dur shur gang rung / dam nyams sogs la tshig rol sum brdeg gong bzhin gyi mthar chems brdung rkang gling / sgang dung rdzogs nas zhwa gyon/ gcig lhag gnyis brdeg 'phar mar bsgyur dung chen la 'dol bya/ hūm̐ rdo rje sogs sh+lau ka gcig la srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs rol/ bh+yoḥyum chen nas gwa dmar chibs la bstod bar 'dur shur gang rung / hūm̐ rab brjid la gnod sbyin 'gyings dbyangs tshig bdun dgu'i khyad bsgyur gnyis brdeg gri gug nas 'dur shur gang rung / bh+yoḥ'adren yang bcug la sha za sogs/ hūm̐ pu tra la pu chen dbyangs tshig bdun dgu'i khyad bsgyur/ klad khrag mon ḍa'i nas 'dur shur gang rung / hūm̐ 'dren bh+yoḥ'adren kun bcug la/ 'phrin las grub par mdzod la tshig rol rnga phyir brdung mthar sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig byas gnyis byas gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ hoḥ'adren hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin ma'i dbyangs dzar bcas sh+lau ka gcig la bya zhing dbyangs rdzogs nas rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ 'theng rkang gsum gong bzhin dgu rdung gcig

gcig gnyis gsum zhes rol mo bzhag mon nag sngon tshe lho phyogs nas 'dur shur gang rung / shan par zhal bzhes la tshig rol dgu rdung / klu sgrub nas khyod nyid la tshig rol dgu rdung / khyad par nas ma thogs la tshig rol dgu rdung / dmar chen nas mngag pa'i la tshig rol dgu rdung / stobs chen nas skad gcig la tshig rol dgu rdung / 'jigs pa'i nas mi nor la tshig rol dgu rdung / rnal 'byor nas byang chub la tshig rol mthar bco lnga brdeg gsum sogs rnga shon rol tshig chems brdung rkang gling drag dung / dung chen la til rdzogs nas slar yang sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum/ dgu brdung gcig gcig gnyis gsum zhes bzhag la/ rkam rlon thun bskyed chog nas nus ldan du gyur zhes dang / 'ur 'don gyi sngags rnams bzla/ 'di'i gzhung nas 'byung ba rnams sa lo chen pos zhus dag ma gnang gong gi yig rnying ltar yin/ suṃ trig sogs tshugs pa dang tshogs par phu 'debs zhu/ thun chog sogs lan gsum/ rnga phyir bltas bzung la ho sogs/ gal te de ltar ma byas na dam las 'das pa yin pas bcol ba'i sogs brjod/ gzhung tshig ni gong ma'i yig rnying sor bzhag yin/ 'dir cung zad bsgyur ba ni las dang po par phan ched yin no/ /gang ltar de ltar zhes pa nas rol mo hod kyis blangs la chems brdung drag dung rkang gling g.yab dar/ slar yang gong bzhin dgu brdung gcig dgug gzhug gsum/ lha dbye tshar gcig la thun brdeg sogs mgon mdos bzhin/ dpang gzug rol gdangs tshang ma mgon mdos bzhin la slob dpon ḍār dri thogs pas 'chams stabs bcol ba'i 'phrin las sogs kyi mthar sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig byas/ gnyis byas/ gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas gcig zhes bzhag la/ hūm̐ nga' nga' zhes dbu mdzad kyis bskul/ de nas gzhan gyis 'jus la nga' wa dus yu gsum mo zhes sogs ma tshig chen po'i 'chams dbyangs da mdzod cig ge we zhes rol mo blangs la grangs bgrang lugs dam tshig chen por dbyangs 'khor gnyis yod pa'i brjes ma bzhin la dgu brdung mgon mdos zor bskul bzhin/

gsod byed nas lha srin la tshig rol dgu rdung / dam nyams nas da lta la tshig rol dgu brdung mthar chems brdung gi skabs skam rlon thun brdeg ral gri snying gar btsugs rnams spor dmigs mchod pa ral gri gyen du bstan pa sogs mgon mdos bzhin drag dung til sogs mthong brgyud bzhin bsgral lo/ /mchod dpon gyis gtor ma rnams la sbran/ rol mo phyi nang gsang ba ma'i 'go bzhin/ rdo rje 'dzin dang la mthong brgyud rnga mi brdung pa'i lugs ni mgon mdos deb tu bris/ 'dir rnga brdung pa'i dbang du btang nas tshig rkang re'i 'gor hūm̐ 'dren bcug pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs rol/ bsgral ba'i nas 'dur shur gang rung / gur mgon ral gcig la tshig rol gyi rjes su sbraṃ gcig ge gnyis zhes rol bskor ngos gsum mam bzhi sogs/ bzhi rdung gsum gcig zhes bzhag yang tshig rkang bzhi la hūm̐ 'dren bcug pa'i dbyangs rol gong bzhin/ stobs chen nas 'dur shur gang rung / mdor na la tshig rol dgu brdung gcig gnyis gsum zhes bzhag la/ thog mar mo de nas pho'i bod rbad bsad gsum gzhung gi grangs ltar 'ur 'don/ de nas gnas khang yangs po gtor chen mtha' la phyin chog yod na langs nas gtor ma la zhal phyogs pas/ hūm̐ skal pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig la bskang gsar spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol de rjes 'dur ma'i mthar sum brdeg gsum/ mgon pos mtshan gsol gyi dbyangs rol sogs mgon mdos bzhin/ gsol kha'i bcom bskul gyi mthar drag rol/ dung rkang gling yang mgon mdos bzhin byas la/ las mgon gyi gtor ma'i mdun nas gsol kha'i rdzas dang khrag chang bstab/ rol mo sum brdeg gsum gyi ring la gtor ma'i g.yas su phyin la gtor ma la zhal phyogs pas/ hūm̐ skal pa la bde chen lhun grub ma'i dbyangs rol/ gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra/ sum brdeg gsum gyis rgyab tu phyin nas gtor ma la zhal phyogs pas/

hūm̐ skal pa la myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma'i dbyangs rol/ gzhan 'dra/ sum brdeg gsum gyis g.yon du phyin nas gtor mar phyogs pas/ hūm̐ skal pa la shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs rol/ gzhan 'dra/ gsum brdeg gsum gyis mdun du phyin nas gtor mar phyogs pas hūm̐/ nga'/ nga'/ zhes dang / skal pa la baiḍūr sngon po'i dbyangs rol/ gzhan 'dra/ gsol kha la bstod pa nas bcom bskul gyi bar lan lnga byed pa 'di rtsa ba'i yig rnying gi dgongs pa rang lugs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun yar klung pa khu dbon nas brgyud kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa la bka' babs pa sor bzhag yin/ rjes ma'i chems brdung rdzogs pa dang / sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum dgu brdung gcig sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum dgu brdung gcig gcig gnyis gsum zhes gral la 'khod/ bzlog pa grangs bsog byed mi byed kyi dbang gis rol tshig rnams thob thang rgyun bzhin/ 'don khrigs kyang rgyun bzhin/ rjes ma'i tshig rol rdzogs pa dang sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas 'theng rkang gnyis dgu brdung gcig 'theng rkang gnyis che gcig byas la hūm̐ ngo bh+yoḥwā ya dpal la ldan ne zhes sogs drag bskul sh+lau ka gcig la bdud rgyal bskul gyi dbyangs rol phyogs bzhi nas 'dur shur gang rung / sprul pa la tshig rol dgu rdung / ha hi nas mthong ba tsam gyis la tshig rol dgu rdung / las mdzad nas til 'bru la tshig rol dgu rdung / rnal 'byor nas las bzhi la tshig rol dgu rdung / gzhung na 'di las med 'on kyang 'phen dus phyi rol du 'don cha rnams kyang byang khyad nang du'ang sgrub ring 'don srol yod pa ni sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi sku thog la tshugs pa'i zhal kyi gtor bzlog skabs mngon spyod rol pa'i sde tshan nang du'ang 'don pa bzhin yin pas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥsogs bud med bskul gyi tshig rol dgu rdung /

chems rdung / de bzhin skyes pa dge slong sngags pa rnams la'ang 'gre/ sngags pa'i chems brdung rdzogs pa dang sum brdeg len can hūm̐ 'dren bcug pa'i mon bu pu tra sh+lau ka gcig gi dbyangs rol/ bskyod cig nas 'dur shur gang rung / bstan pa srung ba la tshig rol dgu brdung bar gong gi rigs 'gre/ hūm̐ 'dren bcug pa'i mon bu bha ṭa sh+lau ka gcig la dbyangs rol sogs nas/ bya ra mdzod la tshig rol dgu brdung bar gong gi rigs 'gre/ bh+yo bh+yoḥzhes lhan cig brjod la sring mo'i dbyangs rol nas dgu brdung bar yang rigs 'gre'i mthar chems brdung dung chen la til sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes zhwa phud/ tshogs sogs mgon bzhin no/ /'phen nyin gsol kha bcom bskul grub nas sum brdeg len can byas la tshogs phud 'bul ba'i bar byas nas skam thun 'byim skyong gru gsum du bgos la blug skam rlon gyi thun de rnams sla ngar bcug gtor chen phab la zhal phyir bsgyur ba sogs gzhung bzhin slob dpon chas zhugs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod bar mgon mdos bzhin/ gdong ma bzhi'i bskul yang bcug gzhung du thun gtor ma gsung yang mgon mdos bzhin byar rung bas drug cu pa sor bzhag la 'phrin bcol bzlog pa med par/ bse mgon drag bskul nas zhal drag bskul/ rdzogs pa dang phyir thon tshul rol tshig mthong thos brgyud pa bzhin ji ltar rigs par bzhi 'gros sogs mthong thos brgyud pa bzhin/ pu tra'i drag bskul hūm̐ dam can mon bu sogs yang 'gro tshul rgyun bzhin/ 'phen pa sleb pa dang gser skyems dpang gzug zor lam dbye ba rnams drug cu bzhin/ zor lam dbye ba'i chems rdung rdzogs nas dgu brdung gnyis bzlog pa drug cu pa bzhin/ drag bskul gyi dbyangs rol tshig rnams gong bzhin/ bu med bskul gtong ring slob dpon rwa zor thogs nas 'phen par 'gros kyis 'gro tshul zur bzlog mda' zor bzhin/

rwa zor dang skam zor gsum 'phang tshul zhal gyi rwa rno'i zor bzhin 'on kyang 'ur kyong mi dgos/ de nas gtor chen ma blang gong bhan phur thogs nas dbyangs rol dang bstun pa'i 'chams tshul/ sring mo'i bskul rdzogs pas dgu brdung la gtor chen thogs nas 'chams dzaṃ lan sogs nas bkra shis rdzogs pa'i bar mgon mdos bzhin la bro brdung mi dgos/ 'dzug gtor 'bul ba'am yang na sang lta bur 'dzug gtor 'bul na nang du slebs nas tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag gtor srid zhi'i dpal 'byor sogs so/ ༈ /yang 'di nyid rkyang pa byed pa ltar na bdag bskyed rang re'i phur chung byed pa'i dbang du btang na phur gtor gcig sman raka chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa/ pu tra'i zur brgyad/ rgyag gtor rnams dang maṇ+ḍal dang gtor drung gi mchod pa las gzhan mchod gtor gang yang mi dgos/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gong bzhin/ phur chung rgyun bzhin/ de nas bzlog gzhung nas 'byung ba'i gnas dang mchod gtor byin rlabs sogs nas bskul rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ tshogs byed na phur chung lugs mi byed na ye shes lnga ldan sogs rgyun bskang lugs so/ /'phen nyin rnam bzhag gzhan gong bzhin la thun gtor bzhi yar slebs nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor man rgyun bzhin/ tshom bu'i gshegs gsol mgon mdos bzhin tshogs byas kha sang nas bsags pa'i lhag ma gzhung bsdus pas gtong lugs sogs phyag len bzhin no// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'phrin las kyi mgon po putra ming sring gi drag po'i gtor chen/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 33
